description: Points a main domain at a Feyn page hosted on Vercel: A @ and CNAME www. Group 'verify' adds the ownership TXT record Vercel sometimes asks for.
variableDescription: txthost: host of Vercel's ownership TXT record, relative to the domain (e.g. _vercel). txtvalue: its value (vc-domain-verify=...). Only used with groupId 'verify'.
